@@U03983@@
There you'd see me riding in a carriage, up and down, this way and that in the noisy traffic, scrambling like scattered heaps of swarming ants. And whenever I drove or rode on horseback, I'd be the center of attention for hundreds of thousands.

@@U03985@@
That could never satisfy me! It’s all very well that people multiply, and in their way live comfortably, learn how to read, get educated— and yet, in the end, what it teaches them is rebellion.

@@U03987@@
Then I'd build myself a pleasure palace, one grand and vast enough to match my worth, with woods, hills, fields, meadows, all converted to a splendid park. Velvety lawns edged with wall-high hedges, walks straight as a die, cleverly managed shade, waterfalls leaping from rock to rock, and fountains, fountains of every sort, a grand jet of water over there, and off to the sides a thousand piddling jets hissing and pissing away. Ah, and then, of course, cozy little cottages built for the loveliest of lovely ladies, where I would spend endless hours in splendid solitude. “Ladies,” I say, for I always think of them in the plural.

@@U03989@@
Mean but modern! A latter day 萨达纳帕洛斯!
translation:
@@U03983@@
在那里，你会看到我坐在一辆马车里，在喧闹的车流中来回走动，像一群群散乱的蚂蚁一样爬行。每当我开车或骑马时，我都会成为数十万人关注的焦点。

@@U03985@@
那永远不能满足我！人们繁衍生息，并以他们的方式过着舒适的生活，学习如何阅读，接受教育，这一切都很好——但最终，这教会了他们叛逆。

@@U03987@@
然后我会为自己建造一座游乐宫殿，一座宏伟而广阔的宫殿，足以与我的价值相匹配，里面有树林、山丘、田野、草地，所有这些都变成了一座美丽的公园。天鹅绒般的草坪边缘有墙高的树篱，像骰子一样笔直行走，巧妙地管理阴影，瀑布从岩石跳跃到岩石，还有喷泉，各种各样的喷泉，那边有一股巨大的水流，旁边有一千个小水流嘶嘶作响，撒尿。啊，当然，还有为最可爱的女士们建造的舒适的小别墅，我会在那里度过无尽的时光，享受美妙的孤独。 “女士们，”我说，因为我总是以复数形式想到她们。

@@U03989@@
卑鄙但现代！末日萨达纳帕洛斯！
